From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@paygrid.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@paygrid.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: PayGrid initial eval results (summary)

Alex / Sarah 

Quick summary from the 10k doc run (high level):

- Llama-3-70B-INT4: FP rate = 2.7% (proprietary baseline = 1.2%). Relative degradation = +125%. Token cost = $0.0068/doc. Latency P95 = 420 ms.
- Mistral-7B-Instruct: FP rate = 1.4% (relative +16%). Token cost = $0.0036/doc. Latency P95 = 210 ms.
- Observations: Llama-3-70B produced stronger recall on complex multi-table invoices but showed more hallucination on OCR-noisy docs. Mistral had lower FP but missed several edge-case table joins.

Attached: paygrid-benchmark-results.csv (raw metrics) and redwood-eval-notes.pdf (3-page summary with failure examples and suggested mitigations).

Immediate recommendations:
- If PayGrid prioritizes strict parity on FP, Mistral-7B-Instruct is closer to your baseline and meets cost goals.
- For maximal match recall on complex invoices, Llama-3-70B can be tuned (prompt engineering + small retrieval augmentation) but will require an iterative calibration window.
- Suggested acceptance thresholds to propose internally: accept if FP <= 1.8% AND human review pass >= 90% for first 30k docs; fallback to proprietary ensemble for documents flagged with high OCR-error tags.

Next steps: 1) Confirm whether you want a targeted tuning run on Llama-3-70B for complex invoices; 2) If yes, we propose a 2-week calibration scope (sample labeling + prompt/temperature sweeps).

Marissa

---
Note: Attachments  paygrid-benchmark-results.csv (24 KB); redwood-eval-notes.pdf (220 KB)

  1) Approve a 2-week calibration on Llama-3-70B (label 3k complex docs) to try to close the FP gap while preserving recall.
  2) In parallel, pilot Mistral-7B-Instruct in production for low-risk routes (simple invoices) to validate downstream UX and ops.
- Confirming Wed 10am PT works for the sync  we'll send a calendar invite.
- Can you sign off on the calibration scope (deliverables: labeled set, weekly checkpoints, success criteria as Marissa proposed) so we can scope engineering/annotation costs?
